entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to make a return. I think. The website was a little confusing and I'm just not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Flores, and the order number is... uh... VF88602. I think.
Thank you, Maria. I see the order for the cycling shoes right here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I... I guess it's a preference? They're just not working for me. I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels every time I ride. I tried adjusting the cleats, thinking maybe that was the problem, but it didn't help. I just feel so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria. I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see here that the shoes were delivered 33 days ago. That's perfectly fine. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the window to send them back for a full refund.
Oh, really? So I can get a refund? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Absolutely. I've already started the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. All you need to do is package the cycling shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off with the carrier. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow, that's great. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so much easier.
You are very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can help you with today at VeloFit?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and happy holidays!
